description.value: A regional cuisine restaurant in Golden offering dine-in service. The business is wheelchair accessible and centrally located on 10th Avenue, making it a convenient stop for touring cyclists passing through the community.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for Eleven 22 is inaccessible—it displays a 404/error page ('Nothing Found') with no business content—so all amenity information relies solely on OSM tags. OSM confirms the restaurant name, address, phone, and indicates it is open (looks_closed: false) with regional cuisine and wheelchair accessibility, but provides no details about cycling-specific amenities. Without website corroboration, all required criteria and optional amenities are unverifiable.
concerns: Website displays 404/error page ('Nothing Found') — unable to verify amenities or current business details online
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real restaurant in Golden with confirmed phone, address, and OSM open status. Lack of website verification does not disqualify it; it remains useful to touring cyclists.
